evidence: Workbook Quality Checks row 35 (A36:D36) requires a defining behavior criterion and proof that server-backed state survives restart. The Render gate grades an authored computed Run (tests/gates/render/judge.toml:17-36), and Constraints grades UI save plus independent clean-context server read and reload (tests/gates/constraints/judge.toml:17-33; prompt.md:14-30). Functional grades the defining last-good preview with a user-edited field and canvas drawing (prompt.md:273-286; judge.toml:165-168), plus library/history reload and restart (judge.toml:325-343,549-553,583-595; prompt.md:426-434). The restart proof has a false-success path: tests/test.sh:130-143,152-178 ignores a failed or ineffective kill of the old process group, launches a replacement, then probe_ready accepts any HTTP response from /api/health or /, without tying the listener to new_pid; tests/tools/restart_mcp.py:30-52 reports success solely from the helper exit code. A detached child listener can survive the group kill and serve all post-restart reads while its data exists only in memory. The indexed scripted golden reports matching S21/S37/S22 readbacks, and all 77 artifact hashes match; it does not exercise this counterexample. The index lacks a raw restart command/log and exact-current configured judge/Oracle/target-model measurements (evidence/35/assessment.json). Thus grading exercises core behavior, but S22 does not reliably prove required process-restart durability. A conforming app with another route or server-rendered read remains eligible under the clean-context gate; public network is not a same-origin demand.
counterexample: Implement /app/server.js as a short launcher that spawns a detached Node child server and exits. Let the child keep snippets, histories and restore-attempt acknowledgements only in Maps. Render and Constraints pass because the child serves real UI writes and reads across clean browser contexts and reloads. At S22, test.sh records/kills the already-exited launcher process group, the detached child keeps port 3000, the replacement cannot bind, and probe_ready still sees the old child. restart_app reports success, and every post-restart read sees the unchanged in-memory state despite no storage surviving a real server restart.
suggested_fix: In a coordinated canonical harness update, fail restart unless the old port-3000 listener has exited and the new launched server owns the ready listener; then freeze and remeasure the candidate.
